name: Galvanised Steel Circular Duct - 1m Length
description: Rigid spiral-wound galvanised steel circular ducting, 1 metre length. Suitable for domestic and commercial ventilation and extraction systems.

name: Galvanised Steel Circular Duct - 3m Length
description: Rigid spiral-wound galvanised steel circular ducting, 3 metre length. Fewer joints on long straight runs means less leakage and faster installation.

name: Galvanised Rectangular Duct - 1m Length
description: Folded galvanised steel rectangular ducting, 1 metre length, for low-profile commercial air distribution where headroom is limited.

name: PVC Flat Channel Rectangular Duct - 1m Length
description: Low-profile white PVC rectangular flat channel ducting, 1 metre length. Perfect for kitchen extraction where space above cabinets is tight.

name: PVC Flat Channel 90 Degree Horizontal Bend
description: White PVC 90 degree horizontal elbow for flat channel ducting, turns a duct run around corners and cabinets.

name: Round-to-Rectangular Duct Adapter
description: Adapter that converts between circular duct and rectangular flat channel, letting you join round spiral duct to low-profile PVC channel.

name: Flexible Aluminium Ducting - 3m
description: Stretchable multi-layer aluminium flexible duct hose, 3 metre length. Ideal for cooker hoods, tumble dryers and awkward duct runs.

name: PVC Flexible Ducting - 6m
description: Lightweight white PVC flexible hose reinforced with a steel wire helix, 6 metre length. Good for bathroom fan and short extraction runs.

name: Insulated Acoustic Flexible Duct - 10m
description: Sound-attenuating flexible ducting with 25mm glass wool insulation and perforated inner core, 10 metre length. Reduces fan noise and condensation in ventilation systems.

name: Circular Duct Connector (Male Coupler)
description: Galvanised steel male-to-male coupler that joins two lengths of circular spiral duct end to end. Push-fit with EPDM rubber lip seal.

name: Galvanised Flange Ring Pair
description: Pair of bolt-together galvanised steel flange rings for making a rigid, demountable flanged joint between two circular duct sections. Includes gasket.

name: Quick-Release Duct Clamp Band
description: Stainless steel quick-release clamping band with EPDM seal that pulls two duct ends together tightly without screws or rivets.

name: Galvanised Circular Duct 90 Degree Bend
description: Pressed galvanised steel 90 degree elbow bend for circular ducting. Push-fit connection with EPDM rubber seal.

name: Galvanised Circular Duct 45 Degree Bend
description: Pressed galvanised steel 45 degree elbow bend for circular ducting, for gentler direction changes with lower pressure loss.

name: Galvanised Circular Duct Reducer
description: Concentric galvanised steel reducer for stepping circular duct runs down to a smaller diameter.

name: Galvanised Circular Duct T-Piece
description: Equal T-piece branch fitting in galvanised steel for splitting circular duct runs.

name: Circular Duct End Cap
description: Galvanised steel blanking end cap for closing off unused circular duct openings and branches.

name: Manual Volume Control Damper
description: Galvanised steel inline volume control damper with locking quadrant handle for balancing airflow in circular duct systems.

name: Backdraught Shutter (Non-Return Damper)
description: Inline non-return valve with lightweight butterfly flaps that stop cold air, smells and draughts blowing back into the room when the fan is off.

name: Circular Intumescent Fire Damper
description: Intumescent fire damper for circular ducting that expands and seals the duct in a fire, maintaining wall and floor fire ratings.

name: Louvred External Wall Vent Grille
description: White plastic louvred external wall grille with fixed shutters and insect screen. Spigot fits standard circular ducting.

name: Egg Crate Ceiling Grille
description: Aluminium egg crate return-air ceiling grille with high free area for extract and return air applications.

name: Quiet Inline Duct Fan
description: Low-noise inline centrifugal extractor fan for mounting inside circular duct runs. 2-speed motor, up to 880 m3/h airflow on the 200mm model.

name: Duct Insulation Wrap - 5m Roll
description: Foil-faced glass mineral wool insulation wrap for thermal and condensation control on circular and rectangular ducting. 5 metre roll, 600mm wide.

name: Aluminium Foil Duct Tape - 50m Roll
description: High-tack pure aluminium foil tape for sealing joints and seams on rigid and flexible ducting. Heat and moisture resistant.
